title: Laws of Chemical Combination
summary: Conservation of mass, constant proportions and Dalton's atomic theory.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 9: Atomic Foundations of Matter

objectives: I can state the law of conservation of mass and the law of constant proportions.
I can use them to calculate masses.
I can describe Dalton's atomic theory and how it explains the laws.
misconceptions: Mass is lost when a gas is given off.
Water from different places has different compositions.
Atoms are destroyed when substances burn.
